## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally.
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has tests, including error cases.
- [ ] `docs/STATUS.md` is updated if code or content changed (CI checks this), plus the other
      documents listed under "Documentation duty" in `CLAUDE.md` when affected.
- [ ] New levels have German and English texts and a reference solution.
- [ ] New dependencies, fonts, images or sounds fit `license-policy.json` and are listed in
      `THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md` if added by hand.
